visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a black baseball cap is centered in the frame, holding a large yellow and white rectangular box labeled 'YURUGUN'. He is gesturing with his hands while looking directly at the camera. The background is split between a deep blue and a vibrant red light. (2) Close-up shots show the details of the box, displaying several cartoonish SD Gundam-style character illustrations. A small circular inset appears briefly showing a woman's face reacting. (3) The man begins opening small blind boxes on a wooden table. He pulls out a white plastic bag and tears it open to reveal a small, rounded plastic figure. (4) Multiple chronological close-up sequences showcase different figures: a pink one with a green bucket, a blue one, and a transparent purple one. The man's hands are seen holding and rotating these objects under bright studio lighting. (5) The man holds up small identification cards that come with each toy, showing the character art on the front and Chinese text on the back. (6) A final scene shows the complete set of ten figures arranged on tiered transparent acrylic stands on the wooden surface. The man points towards them and then back at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic Mandarin male voice introducing the product over an upbeat, major-key electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a change in focus to the box. (3) Crisp tearing sounds of plastic bags and the light clicking of plastic parts are heard as the man unboxes the toys. (4) Multiple cartoonish 'boing' and 'pop' sound effects are synchronized with visual reveals of funny character features. (5) A brief female voice interjects with a high-pitched exclamation of 'So cute!'. (6) The vocal intensity increases towards the end with a rising intonation for the call to action, accompanied by a final rhythmic synth swell.
